objective: Select a small physical intervention support with an exact gain threshold and protected constraints under a finite dose cap.
context: Constructed orthogonal-source family with eight editable directions, supports of size at most three, protected rows, normalized score and an exact affine-sphere reduction. A small tied ranker proposes candidates; independent rational checks determine success.

steps.name: Write normalized intervention
steps.description: Define physical dose, baseline normalization and target/protected scores.

steps.name: Reduce to affine sphere
steps.description: Introduce scaled variables and derive the equality and cap constraints.

steps.name: Enumerate supports
steps.description: Explain why size-three supports cover smaller supports and derive the count.

steps.name: Compute exact feasibility
steps.description: Derive rational threshold checks and identify the boundary conditions.

steps.name: Train and compare rankers
steps.description: Compare random, magnitude, tangent, analytic and learned orders under a fixed verifier budget.

steps.name: Report evidence
steps.description: Count actually replayed checks, solvable-root ceiling, label cost and limitations.

specific_questions.prompt: Derive the affine-sphere representation and physical-dose cap from the declared normalized edit model.
Explain why checking every size-three support suffices for a support size upper bound of three; state the combinatorial count.
Give an example where a large target magnitude selects a support that cannot preserve a protected readout.
Explain when fewer exact verifier calls can reduce total compute, accounting for candidate scoring and training-label cost.

native_verifier: sccg01 support_gym.py exact finite rational support checks and independent float controls.
